bio: I'm a cross-border ecommerce specialist with hands-on experience scaling online stores across the UK, US, and global markets. My expertise spans dropshipping operations, TikTok automation, product sourcing, and multi-platform store management.
With a deep understanding of platform algorithms, compliance requirements, and supplier ecosystems, I help clients build sustainable, profitable ecommerce businesses — from zero to fully automated.
Based in Pakistan, I've navigated the complexities of international selling, fintech solutions, and digital creator monetization to deliver real results for clients worldwide.
